Name: Update Tracker
Author: wh0pp
Description:
[size=6][b]Update Tracker[/b][/size]

[b]No mod manager? No problem.[/b]

If your Mods folder is a hand-curated pile of unzipped downloads, SMAPI's update alerts scroll past in the console and are easy to miss. Update Tracker puts them where you can't: a small button on the title screen. See what needs updating [i]before[/i] you load a save, open the exact Nexus page for each mod, and ignore the ones you're deliberately not updating.

No mod manager, no account linking, no API keys, no extra downloads 🚀 🚀 🚀 It just reuses the update check SMAPI already runs.

[line]

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]A small button in the bottom-left of the title screen.[/*]
[*]Shows a skull when updates are available and the happy pink cat when everything is up to date.[/*]
[*]A notification badge counts how many updates are waiting.[/*]
[*]Click the button for a centered list of your installed mods that have a Nexus page.[/*]
[*]Mods with updates are listed first, with [i]installed -> latest[/i] versions.[/*]
[*]Every row has an [b]Open[/b] button that takes you straight to that mod's Nexus page.[/*]
[*]Click the bell to ignore a mod. Ignored mods get a red X over the bell, stop counting toward the badge, and are remembered across sessions.[/*]
[*]Scroll long lists with the mouse wheel; Esc, the X, or a click outside closes the list.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Why use it if you install mods by hand?[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]You don't have to watch the SMAPI console for update alerts that disappear as the game loads.[/*]
[*]You get a clear to-do list before you start playing, instead of discovering an outdated mod mid-save.[/*]
[*]Clicking [b]Open[/b] saves you searching Nexus for the mod you just saw on the title screen.[/*]
[*]Ignoring a mod is persistent, so optional or intentionally pinned mods stop nagging you.[/*]
[*]Works with large hand-managed Mods folders, including mods SMAPI skips because of missing dependencies.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15[/b] or later[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] [b]4.0.0[/b] or later[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI (if you haven't already).[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
No mod manager needed. The zip contains a single [b]UpdateTracker[/b] folder; drop it in [b]Mods[/b] and you're done. Nothing else to configure.

[size=5][b]Usage[/b][/size]
Once the title screen has finished loading, the button appears in the bottom-left corner. Click it to open the list.

[list]
[*][b]Open[/b] opens that mod's Nexus Mods page in your browser.[/*]
[*][b]Bell[/b] ignores or un-ignores a mod. Ignored mods still appear in the list, but no longer count toward the badge.[/*]
[/list]
Ignored mods are saved in [b]config.json[/b] in the mod folder, so your choices survive restarts.

[line]

[size=5][b]How it works / limitations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The mod reads SMAPI's existing update-check results. It does not contact Nexus or any other API, and needs no API key or account.[/*]
[*]Only mods with a Nexus update key in their manifest are listed. Mods whose updates come from other sites are intentionally left out.[/*]
[*]If [b]CheckForUpdates[/b] is disabled in SMAPI's settings (or the check fails, e.g. offline), no update badges will appear.[/*]
[*]SMAPI also checks mods that it skips during loading (such as mods with missing dependencies); those are recovered from SMAPI's console update alerts. Skipped mods that are already up to date cannot be listed.[/*]
[*]No Harmony patches. The button uses its own artwork; the ignore bells use the game's chat emoji texture.[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional and only affects where the button sits (next to its gear). It is not required.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Pathoschild for [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], which provides the update data.[/*]
[/list]
